lines:
Responsibilities: Computes branch/object reachability, verifies published history, prepares explicit non-destructive repair alternatives, and collects only provably unreachable staging/orphan/quarantine objects after policy grace. It never rewrites or compacts published history.
Owned noncanonical records/DTOs: IntegrityReportV1 lists manifest/head-claim/head-record/segment/checkpoint/snapshot/artifact hashes and failures; ReachabilitySnapshotV1 records roots and scan generation; RepairPlanV1 identifies exact expected hashes and permitted pointer-only or new-child-branch actions; OrphanCandidateV1 records local first-seen scan generation and grace status. Optional .maintenance reports are export-excluded and have no authority.
Reachability and repair: roots are every valid session/branch manifest, durable branch-head ref, immutable head claim, pinned export, and user retention pin. Parent/hash edges determine order and reachability. A corrupt reachable object or ambiguous/multiple tip makes the branch read-only; the module reports all verified alternatives. Core Recovery may authorize restoring only an unambiguous ref to an already-verified immutable HeadRecord, or creating a new repair/continuation branch with explicit lineage. Segments, events, snapshots, checkpoints, and reachable artifacts are never edited, truncated, reordered, or deleted.
Retention/orphan behavior: temporary files, failed-CAS candidates, unreachable head records/claims/segments/checkpoints/artifacts, and expired quarantine reports become collectible only after repeated scans plus configured grace and a final locked reachability recheck. Filesystem timestamps may support local age policy but never history order. Anything that becomes reachable is removed from the deletion set. Published retention is append-only through new lineage; no in-place compaction exists.
Ports: ScanIntegrity, PlanRepair, ApplyAuthorizedRefRepair, EnumerateOrphans, and CollectApprovedOrphans. Mutating maintenance requires exact expected hashes and a trusted-core Recovery decision; import uses validation-only scans.
NFRs/non-responsibilities: incremental bounded IO, resumable scans, quotas, cancellation, checksummed reports, and observable corruption/orphan metrics. No semantic invention, automatic newest-tip choice, side-effect compensation/replay, authority/rebind decision, Git operation, or deletion of published history.

data.name: Integrity, Repair Plan, Retention & Orphan Collector
data.technology: Rust incremental hash-graph scanner with guarded pointer repair and reachability-based orphan GC
